acceptance: A migration creates project-owned Run and Run-event persistence with explicit keys/constraints and RLS enabled on every newly exposed table; anonymous access is denied and tenant isolation is enforced.
Owner/editor/viewer tests prove owner and editor mutation authority, viewer read-only behavior, unrelated-user isolation, and no privilege escalation through membership or record identifiers.

Event append semantics remain zero-based, contiguous, append-only, immutable, and concurrency-safe; duplicate identity/sequence, gaps, regressions, and conflicting concurrent appends fail closed without changing previously accepted history.
Run persistence preserves exact RunRecord identity/target/state/parent semantics and rejects lifecycle updates that violate SG-000038; forbidden transitions are atomic non-mutations.
The control-plane adapter uses the existing server-only verified actor/publishable-key boundary and rejects service-role/secret/generated-app configuration exactly as P01-S05 requires.

Protocol round-trip tests prove durable Run/Event records preserve exact logical identities, RevisionBinding values, event source/target/references/kind/sequence, and deterministic ascending replay through the SG-000039 EventStore boundary.
Implementation of SG-000038, SG-000039, and this durable adapter is required before parent IN-P03-S01-T01 can be claimed complete; shaping alone is not implementation proof.

Any implementation candidate must pass repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, truthful Diffcipline proof at the security-sensitive risk tier, checksum-verified Alibaba Open Code Review, required credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head CI, normal merge, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Exact base/head/merge-base and complete migration/adapter/test changed-file accounting.
RLS/privilege/tenant-isolation tests, Run lifecycle atomicity tests, append concurrency/conflict tests, protocol round-trip tests, and full repository verification.
Diffcipline security-sensitive proof, Alibaba OCR evidence, credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head semantic review, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: Reuse the P01-S05 authenticated control-plane Supabase trust domain, SG-000038 lifecycle semantics, and SG-000039 EventStore contract. Add only the durable project-owned adapter and database enforcement needed to close persistence; do not create a second data plane or absorb artifacts/budgets/providers.

requirements: No service-role or generated-application credential may become ambient control-plane authority; all ordinary access remains authenticated, project-scoped, server-only, and RLS-constrained.
Event history is immutable and append-only under concurrency; database and adapter layers must both fail closed rather than silently repair, overwrite, reorder, or cross-bind events.
Database persistence does not grant capability, prove external execution, or create acceptance/PASS authority; it records typed state/evidence only.

outcome: Ineractive can durably persist project-owned RunRecord and append-only EventRecord history in the authenticated control-plane Supabase domain while preserving SG-000038 lifecycle semantics, SG-000039 event ordering/replay invariants, tenant isolation, editor/viewer authority, and the existing server-only no-service-role credential boundary.
rationale: SG-000038 shapes deterministic Run lifecycle semantics and SG-000039 shapes the provider-neutral append-only EventStore contract/reference behavior, but neither provides durable persistence. P03-S01 requires an event store that survives process/session loss. P01-S05 already established an authenticated control-plane Supabase trust domain with project ownership/membership, RLS, server-only configuration, and explicit separation from generated-application backends. The smallest safe durable step is therefore a project-owned Run/Event adapter in that existing domain rather than a new hidden data plane or privileged service-role store.

risk.recovery: Revert only the new Run/Event control-plane migration, adapter, policy tests, and integration wiring; SG-000014 project storage, SG-000038 lifecycle shaping, SG-000039 provider-neutral EventStore shaping, and existing project data remain intact.

scope_in: Add durable control-plane persistence for RunRecord and EventRecord under an existing Ineractive project identity; every persisted Run belongs to exactly one project and every persisted Event belongs to exactly one persisted Run.

Extend the existing control-plane Supabase migration surface with RLS-protected Run and Run-event storage that preserves canonical logical identities, Run state/parent binding, exact target RevisionBinding, Event source/target/references, kind, and per-Run sequence without lossy reinterpretation.

Reuse the existing verified authenticated actor, server-only control-plane Supabase configuration, publishable-key boundary, and generated-application credential separation; service-role/secret credentials remain forbidden for ordinary store initialization.

Define project access so the project owner and editor members may create/advance Runs and append Events, viewer members remain read-only, unrelated authenticated users cannot read or mutate the records, and anonymous access remains denied.

Enforce immutable append-only Event history at both adapter and database boundaries: no ordinary event update/delete authority, globally unique Event identity, unique per-Run sequence, zero-based contiguous ordering, and concurrency-safe rejection of gaps/regressions/duplicate positions without silent repair.

Persist Run lifecycle changes only when they satisfy the canonical SG-000038 transition contract; persistence success cannot widen lifecycle semantics, and a failed/forbidden transition cannot partially mutate durable state.
Define deterministic per-Run ordered reads/replay through the SG-000039 EventStore boundary and round-trip tests proving stored records preserve exact protocol meaning.
scope_out: No generated-application Supabase table, credential, migration, RLS policy, or service-role authority; no cross-use of generated-app backend configuration in the Ineractive control plane.

No model/provider/tool routing, capability grants, scheduler/retry execution, artifact store, budget governor, memory, browser/runtime orchestration, release/deployment, observability export, or P02 work.
No new acceptance/PASS authority from database presence, no direct model-generated production SQL execution, and no claim that table persistence proves runtime success or external side effects.

No arbitrary deletion or mutation of accepted Event history. Explicit project deletion may cascade owned Run/Event rows as part of the existing user-owned project lifecycle, but this is not an event rewrite mechanism.
title: IN-P03-S01-T01C authenticated durable Run/Event control-plane persistence
